ask: What validation rules should the Grades table have?

content.text: The data supports one rule worth adding: Name is filled in on all 67 records, so require a value (Not empty). GPA and Study Hours per Week are also always filled in, but nothing else in the data (a value list, unique values) suggests a rule for them. Shall I propose the Name rule?
